title: Machine learning predicts severe mental distress in college students from survey data
summary: Six machine learning models were trained on survey data from 2088 students at five universities; extreme gradient boosting performed best (AUC 0.932, 95% CI 0.911-0.949) and gave an AUC of 0.918 in external validation on 751 students from three universities. The model was deployed as a web application. The data are cross-sectional questionnaires, so the result is a risk-prediction tool, not evidence of causes or of intervention benefit.
ai_technology: Extreme gradient boosting selected among six machine learning models, deployed as a web app

evidence.tested: Random 80/20 training and validation split and external validation on 751 students.
evidence.unknown: Whether use of the tool improves intervention outcomes; cross-sectional design; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts severe mental distress from demographics, eating, lifestyle and sport habits.
